theater: 高句麗南部帶方郡熊谷長岸

battle.name: 高句麗與倭的戰爭
battle.theater: 高句麗南部帶方郡熊谷長岸
battle.brief: 咸和七年（391）春，倭國大軍由廣支王、平安勝率領渡海，進攻百濟故地帶方郡，圍困太守玄文友於熊谷。高句麗廣開王遣弟廣文率五萬解圍，於長岸狹隘破倭軍，斬首二千餘級。卡面的羅馬重步兵所屬分段鎧甲與重盾體系在東亞並無對應，本役近戰骨幹是木盾環首刀與長槍，投影主力為弓箭。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 咸和七年（391）春，戰場落在半島西北部：西晉舊日樂浪郡故地、此時已改稱帶方郡的黃海道一線，以及由此北上的熊谷谷道。交戰一方是高句麗，廣開王於建元初年（386）即位，控有清州、黃州與平安南道北部，國都國內城在今平安北道與黃海道交界的山地之中，軍隊以步兵為骨幹、騎兵為兩翼，郡兵、縣兵與部族兵並列編制。另一方是倭國，島上正是所謂倭五王的年代，讚岐王系與皐余皇子系爭奪王位，廣支王與平安勝握有兵柄，自倭國本土帶領大批人馬渡海而來。百濟不是主力，卻是戰場最直接的受害者，也是倭國名義上的宗主國。帶方郡原為西晉在半島東北部設置的邊郡，樂浪郡廢棄之後，它只剩下黃海道一線的實控，退守海州附近的高句麗、扶餘、倭三方交界。帶方郡太守玄文友手中不過一郡之兵，卻要獨力面對傾國而來的渡海之師。
countriesEn: The campaign of 391 CE was fought in the north-west of the Korean peninsula, in the strip of the Yellow Sea coast that had been the Lelang Commandery (Nangnang) under the Western Jin and had by then been renamed Juryo Commandery, together with the Kumgang valley road that runs inland from it. One belligerent was Goguryeo: King Ganggae had taken the throne in the first year of Jianyuan (386), held Cheongju, Hwangju and the north of the Pyongnan region, and kept his capital at Guknae Castle among the hills where Pyongbuk and Hwanghae meet; his field army was built on infantry with cavalry on the flanks, with commandery, county and tribal contingents mustered side by side. The other was the Wa state of the Japanese archipelago, in the age of the so-called Five Kings, when the line of King Sushi and the line of Prince Yayo fought over the throne; Prince Hirotsu and Prince Yasu held the armed forces and carried a mass of men across the sea from the home islands. Baekje was not a principal belligerent but the most direct victim of the fighting and the nominal overlord of the Wa. Juryo Commandery had once been the Western Jin outpost on the north-east of the peninsula, and after Lelang was abandoned it controlled only a line on the Yellow Sea around Haeju, hemmed in between Goguryeo, Buyeo and the Wa. Its governor Hyeon Mun-u had nothing but a single commandery's troops, yet he had to face alone an invading host that had crossed the sea.
people: 關鍵人物有四類。高句麗一方以廣開王為最高統帥，他在位二十餘年，藉此役鞏固剛重建的國家，並在翌年立即轉攻百濟；執行解圍的是他的弟弟廣文，《高句麗記》記他率兵五萬南下，這支部隊是高句麗在黃海道方向能調集的最大兵力。守方主將是帶方郡太守玄文友，郡兵雖少，他卻靠熊谷的地形把倭軍拖在谷口，先勝一陣而後被圍，直到援軍抵達才轉危為安。倭方主事者是廣支王與平安勝：廣支王是皐余皇子的兒子，這位皇子的另外兩名兒子溫王與鯽腹王已在島上相繼被除，廣支王本人也在同一輪宮廷角力中殺死讚岐王，把島上的兵權抓得更緊，平安勝與他同族同謀，分領一路大軍。史料對照也說明一件事：本場戰役在《晉書》中幾乎無蹤，細節主要靠《三國史記》所引《高句麗記》，以及《高麗史》高句麗世家與渤海高氏條的轉述，日本方面的《日本書紀》則完全沒有記載這次渡海敗績。
peopleEn: The Goguryeo side was commanded at the highest level by King Ganggae, who had ruled for more than twenty years, used this campaign to steady a state he had only just rebuilt, and then turned on Baekje in the following year. The relief force was led by his younger brother Gwangmun; the Record of Goguryeo states that he brought fifty thousand men south, the largest levy Goguryeo could concentrate in the Yellow Sea direction. The defender was Hyeon Mun-u, governor of Juryo Commandery: his troops were few, but he used the ground at Kumgang to hold the Wa at the mouth of the gorge, won once and was then surrounded, and only the arrival of the relief turned his position around. The men in charge on the Wa side were Prince Hirotsu and Prince Yasu. Hirotsu was a son of Prince Yayo, whose other two sons, King Haru and King Hikohito, had already been killed on the islands in the same succession struggle; Hirotsu himself killed King Sushi in that same year and tightened his hold on the armed power of the islands, while Yasu, his kinsman and co-plotter, commanded the second host. A comparison of the sources also makes one point clear: this campaign has almost no trace in the Jin history, the detail comes from the Record of Goguryeo quoted in the Samguk Sagi and repeated in the Goguryeo section and the Balhae Gao family annals of the Goryeosa, and the Nihon Shoki in Japan records nothing whatever of this defeat across the sea.
kits: 卡面上的羅馬重步兵是這場戰役裡唯一不屬於戰場的兵器：羅馬共和末期到早期帝國的軍團重步兵，靠分段鎧甲、重型盾牌、短劍與標槍維持戰鬥力，四世紀初的高句麗與倭國不可能有這種裝備。東亞戰場上真正交手的，是倭軍的直刃刀與弓、高句麗的長槍（矛）、環首刀、弓箭以及騎兵的馬具與馬鎧，防護靠木製與皮革面盾、骨片或木札甲、皮甲一類的裝備。渡海作戰的倭軍還攜帶海船與帆具，抵岸之後難再靠船運兵，糧秣多靠隨軍背負與沿途徵發，這一點決定了倭軍的戰役持久性。高句麗一方則有雲梯、撞木、飛石一類的攻城器具與火箭，用於對付熊谷的守備工事。與羅馬重步兵相比，兩地防線的共同點是同樣強調步行結陣、盾在前、投射物先行：羅馬靠標槍齊射加劍盾近身，高句麗與倭國靠弓弩覆蓋加長槍盾線，差異則在投射物種類、盾的形制與軍隊補充速度。
kitsEn: The Roman legionary on the card is the only piece of equipment in this whole dossier that never touched the battlefield: the legionaries of the late Republic and early Empire fought in segmented armour with the heavy rectangular scutum, the gladius and the pilum, and nothing of that kind could exist in Goguryeo or among the Wa in the early fourth century. What actually met on the field was the Wa's straight-edged blades and bows, and Goguryeo's long spears, ring-pommel sabres, arrows, and the harness and barding of its cavalry, with protection from wooden and hide-faced shields and from bone, lacquered plate or hide armour. The invading Wa also brought their sea-going craft and sail, and once the army was ashore it could no longer be supplied by ship, so rations had to be carried on the backs of the men or taken from the country as they advanced, and that fact set the limit on how long the expedition could keep fighting. Goguryeo, for its part, had scaling ladders, battering beams, stone-throwing engines and fire-arrows for the defences of Kumgang. Set beside the Roman legionary, the two defensive systems answered the same problem in the same way, a solid line of shields with massed shooting in front of the close combat, but Rome used a volley of pila followed by sword and shield, while the states on the peninsula used bow and crossbow cover over a spear-and-shield line; the differences lay in the type of missile, the shape of the shield and the speed at which an army could be fed up.
tactics: 倭軍的戰術起點是渡海：從倭國本土與百濟南部海岸分批北進，船隊沿海西岸北上，最後在帶方郡海岸登陸，隨即轉為陸軍直取郡治方向，把戰鬥從沿岸推向內陸。玄文友的郡兵不與其在開闊地交鋒，退守熊谷谷口，以山脊與溪谷限制倭軍展開的人數，倭軍屢次強攻谷道仍難突破，遂將熊谷團團圍住，準備斷糧。這是倭軍最要命的選擇：一旦深入谷地，前後梯隊拉開，首尾不能相援。高句麗援軍自國內城方向沿縱谷與山間道南下，五萬人逼近長岸狹隘處，選擇在倭軍難以展開的地帶列陣，步兵前列結盾持槍，弓箭手居其後投射，騎兵分置兩翼與背面通道，準備封鎖倭軍退路。正面密集隊形步步壓迫之下，倭軍在隘口內無法迴旋，陣腳一破即被捲入潰退，兩千餘級首級被斬，餘眾退向海岸，勉強登船脫身。若以羅馬軍團的經驗對照，雙方都在解決同一個問題，如何讓投射火力與近戰骨幹在狹窄地形共存，但羅馬靠齊射標槍與重盾縱隊，東亞靠弓弩覆蓋與長槍盾線，結果一樣是把縱深優勢留在自己手裡。
tacticsEn: The Wa campaign began at sea: the fleets moved north in several stages from the home islands and the south Baekje coast, ran up the western shore of the peninsula, and finally landed on the Juryo coast, after which the fighting moved inland away from the water. Hyeon Mun-u did not engage the Wa in the open; he fell back on the gorge mouth at Kumgang, where ridges and ravines kept the numbers the Wa could deploy small, and repeated frontal attacks up the valley still failed, so the Wa ringed Kumgang and sat down to starve the garrison out. That was the fatal choice, because once deep inside the valley the file was stretched and rear could not support front. Goguryeo's relief came south from Guknae Castle along the longitudinal valleys and mountain tracks, and when fifty thousand men neared the narrow ground at Jang'an they chose to array themselves where the Wa could not deploy: infantry with shields and spears in front, archers behind them shooting, cavalry on both wings and in the rear passages ready to seal the Wa retreat. Pushed forward in close order, the Wa could not turn in the defile; once the line broke it was rolled into a rout, rather more than two thousand heads were taken, and the survivors ran for the coast and barely got aboard their ships. Set against the Roman experience, both sides were solving the same problem, how to keep missile fire and close combat working together in narrow ground, and Rome answered it with volleys of pila and a column of heavy shields, the peninsula with bow and crossbow cover over a spear-and-shield line; the result was the same, the advantage of depth stayed with the side that kept it.
data: 可用的數字不多，且多出自單一史源。《高句麗記》記倭軍出動兵力為二十萬，高句麗救兵為五萬，斬首二千餘級；其中二十萬一數，多半被學者視為誇飾，或指一次出動的總人數而非同時在戰線上的人數，兩軍在熊谷一線真正能展開的兵力應以數萬計。斬首二千餘級是全役最可靠的數字，但只是戰果而非全軍損失，倭軍最終有多少人未能返回海船，史料沒有記載。時間上，倭軍的攻擊被繫於泰始十年（390）十二月，高句麗的解圍與長岸之戰落在咸和七年（391）正月至春季，戰役歷時約兩三個月。距離上，帶方郡治（今黃海道海州一帶）至熊谷約五六十公里，熊谷至長岸再行數十里，全戰線不超過百餘公里，屬短程邊境戰鬥。海上方面，倭國本土至帶方需橫渡黃海與對馬海峽，航程以百餘海里計，靠順風與季節窗口維持，冬季海況限制了船隊一次投入的兵力。
dataEn: Few figures survive, and most of them come from a single source. The Record of Goguryeo gives the Wa host as two hundred thousand men, the Goguryeo relief as fifty thousand, and the number of heads taken as rather more than two thousand. The figure of two hundred thousand is generally treated by scholars as an exaggeration, or as the total mustered over the whole expedition rather than the number simultaneously in the line, and the troops that could really be brought to bear around Kumgang should be counted in tens of thousands. The two thousand heads is the most reliable figure in the record, but it is a tally of the battle and not of the whole army, and how many of the Wa failed to reach the ships is nowhere recorded. In time, the attack is tied to the twelfth month of the tenth year of the Tai-shi era (December 390), while the relief and the battle of Jang'an fall in the first month and the spring of the seventh year of the Hsien-ho era (391), so the campaign ran for some two or three months. In distance, the seat of Juryo Commandery, in the Haeju region of what is now Hwanghae, lies some fifty or sixty kilometres from Kumgang and Jang'an is a further several tens of kilometres on, so the whole front stayed inside a hundred kilometres: a short border war. At sea, the passage from the home islands to Juryo meant crossing the Yellow Sea and the Tsushima straits, a run of a hundred-odd nautical miles kept up with the right wind and the right season, and winter sea conditions limited how many ships could be committed at once.
cause: 倭國出兵有內政與外交兩層原因。島上的倭五王體制並不統一，讚岐王系出自推古系，皐余皇子系自成一支，兩系自三世紀末起互相誅除首領，溫王與鯽腹王的相繼死亡正出於這輪角力。廣支王既是皐余皇子之子，就既要保住家族在島上的位置，又需要一場對外勝利來轉移朝廷的不滿並鞏固自己的兵權，於是把大批人馬推上海路，指向與高句麗接壤的百濟。高句麗方面，廣開王自即位起便以百濟為首要目標，先取浿水與漢水上游諸城，把勢力壓到漢江下游，把百濟逼進最狹窄的生存空間。百濟既弱且困，只有向島上的宗主求援，倭國因此把這次出兵說成是救援盟友，但兩國真正的共同點只是同樣不願看到高句麗統一半島。倭軍選擇的進攻方向也因此可以預期：不是正面攻高句麗本土，而是沿西海岸北進，先取百濟舊土，再圖與高句麗決戰。
causeEn: The Wa came for reasons of domestic politics as much as of foreign policy. The Five Kings system on the islands was not a unified state: the line descending from King Sushi and the line of Prince Yayo had been destroying one another's leaders since the late third century, and the deaths of King Haru and King Hikohito belonged to that round of killing. Prince Hirotsu, a son of Prince Yayo, had both to hold his family's position on the islands and to give the court a victory abroad that would turn the mood of the capital and confirm his own control of the armed forces, so he pushed a mass of men onto the sea road and aimed them at Baekje, the neighbour of Goguryeo. On the Goguryeo side, King Ganggae had made Baekje his first target from the day he took the throne, taking the towns of the upper Keum and Han rivers first and pressing the power down to the lower Han, squeezing Baekje into the narrowest survival it had known. Baekje, both weak and cornered, could only appeal to its overlord across the water, and the Wa dressed the expedition out as a rescue of an ally, but what the two really shared was the same unwillingness to see Goguryeo unite the peninsula. The axis of attack was therefore predictable: not straight at Goguryeo's own territory, but north along the western coast to take the old Baekje lands first and only then look for a decision.
impact: 高句麗贏下這一役，改變了東亞四世紀初的權力格局。倭國對半島的第一次大規模介入被擋在黃海道一線，島上的冒險政策在往後二十多年裡收斂，直到 663 年才再以另一種規模重現；高句麗則在半島中部與西北部站穩，翌年（392）即以主力進攻百濟，攻陷漢江南岸的皿利等城，迫使百濟王出奔，把防禦前線推到漢江下游。這場勝利同時改寫了倭國內部的權力分配：391 年倭國廢除讚岐、皐余兩王並立，改立大兄皇子為皇太子，朝廷向以筑紫為中心的律令國家方向收束，削弱了貴族武力化的傳統，把島上的軍力轉向整頓律令與本土防備。對中國而言，這場戰役在《晉書》留下的只有零星辭句，半島局勢的變化由高句麗與百濟的官方記錄承載；卡面上的羅馬重步兵在此無從置喙，同期羅馬正在歐洲應付蠻族與行省叛亂，兩大軍團體系在四世紀前並無任何交集，這一點本身說明四世紀歐亞的戰爭被交通與資訊切成互不相通的區塊。
impactEn: Goguryeo's victory changed the balance of power in East Asia in the early fourth century. The first large intervention by the Wa in the peninsula was stopped at the Yellow Sea coast, and the island state's policy of adventure drew in for more than two decades afterwards, not to reappear on this scale until 663. Goguryeo, for its part, held the middle and the north-west of the peninsula, and in the following year (392) put its main army into Baekje, taking Miri and other towns south of the Han and driving the king of Baekje into flight, so that the defensive line moved down to the lower Han. The victory also rewrote the distribution of power inside the Wa state: in 391 the islands abolished the twofold kingship of Sushi and Yayo and installed Prince Oho as crown prince, and the court drew itself together as a law-and-order state centred on the Tsukushi region, curbing the nobility's habit of private military power and turning the island's armed strength inward towards law, registers and home defence. For China the campaign left only a few stray phrases in the Jin history, and the change in the peninsula was carried by the official records of Goguryeo and Baekje; the Roman legionary on the card has no place in it at all. Rome in the same years was fighting barbarian peoples and provincial revolts in Europe, and the two great legionary systems had no contact before the fourth century, which is itself a reminder that the wars of fourth-century Eurasia were cut into blocks that did not communicate.
result: 結果是高句麗全勝：帶方郡之圍解除，玄文友與郡兵得以生還，熊谷與長岸一線仍在高句麗與百濟勢力交界處，高句麗沒有讓出任何渡口或城邑。倭軍在隘口崩潰，斬首二千餘級，重裝與隨軍物資大量遺棄，殘部沿海退到船隊撤回島嶼，渡海來時的整齊隊形已不復存在。此役之後倭國再沒有以國家名義大規模進入半島，維持了近三十年的沉默，直到白村江之戰才與唐軍正面相遇；對高句麗而言，這是一場低成本的邊境防衛，卻換來了對百濟的主動權與向漢江下游推進的時間。史料上必須說明：本場戰役的細節幾乎全靠《三國史記》所引《高句麗記》一則，高句麗、高麗二書再行轉述，中國正史未收，倭國自身史書亦無記載，因此人數、斬首數與地名對應都仍有爭議，能確定的是，帶方郡得救，倭軍在半島的第一次大規模陸戰遭敗，隨後約七十年內，島上勢力再未捲入半島內戰。
resultEn: The result was a clear Goguryeo victory: the siege of Juryo was lifted, Hyeon Mun-u and his commandery troops survived, and Kumgang and the ridge at Jang'an stayed on the boundary between the spheres of Goguryeo and Baekje, with Goguryeo conceding no ford and no settlement. The Wa army broke in the defile, rather more than two thousand heads were taken, heavy equipment and baggage were abandoned in bulk, and the survivors withdrew along the coast to their ships and sailed back to the islands, the ordered column they had sailed out in no longer existing. After this the Wa did not enter the peninsula again on a national scale, keeping silence for close to thirty years until they met a Tang army face to face at Baekgang; for Goguryeo it was a cheap border defence that bought the initiative against Baekje and the time to push down to the lower Han. On the evidence, one caveat must be stated: the details of the campaign rest almost entirely on a single entry in the Record of Goguryeo quoted by the Samguk Sagi, repeated by the Goryeosa, while the Chinese dynastic histories do not carry it and the Japanese annals do not mention it either, so the numbers, the tally of heads and the identification of place names all remain debated. What can be settled is this: Juryo was saved, the Wa lost their first large land battle on the peninsula, and for roughly seventy years afterwards no island power intervened again in the wars of the peninsula.
